basic_details.job_title: PFI Advisor- HR & Liaison Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Power Foundation of India (PFI) invites applications from eligible candidates for the engagement of an Advisor- HR & Liaison on a short-term contractual basis. The position is for 1 post, and the last date to submit applications in the prescribed format is 30.11.2026 up to 06:00 P.M.

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: The engagement is open to executives from CPSEs or the Government sector only. Applicants must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of application. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: About Power Foundation of India
content_sections.text: Power Foundation of India (PFI) is an organisation with its office located at B-28, Qutab Institutional Area, New Delhi-110016. PFI undertakes engagements for organisational requirements and satisfactory performance through short-term contractual appointments.

content_sections.heading: PFI Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the application fee, the exact qualification requirements, or the application submission mode other than stating that candidates shall submit applications in the prescribed format.

rows.details: The notice does not mention the educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates shall submit applications in the prescribed format to the organisation. The application format and details are available on the Power Foundation of India's website www.powerfoundation.org.in under the link "Careers". content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions: The engagement is open to executives from CPSEs or the Government sector only. Applicants must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of application. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: Tenure and Contractual Terms
content_sections.text: The contractual engagement shall initially be for a period of two years. It may be extended for a further period of one year, subject to organizational requirements and satisfactory performance.
